c_cmd_s.name: c_cmd_s
c_cmd_s.method: null-kernel BO sweep, intercept of t = c_cmd + c_bo*n_bos (npu basis, median of 100)
caveats: near-null kernel: floor only
medians; warmed — cold first-command values are much higher (cf. R63)

c_bo_s.name: c_bo_s
caveats: H4 caps BOs at 5 data-arg slots
the null graph uses one core and therefore measures only two and three total BOs; that core has two input DMA channels

c_call_s.name: c_call_s
c_call_s.method: byte-independent intercept of pack + deblock (direct, not by subtraction)
evidence: 4096 B: pack=    3.74 us deblock=    2.30 us (alloc=7979.46 sync=3.74 back=1.41 numpy=0.89)
16384 B: pack=    3.55 us deblock=    2.37 us (alloc=6378.15 sync=3.55 back=1.48 numpy=0.89)

262144 B: pack=    8.58 us deblock=    4.29 us (alloc=6362.26 sync=8.58 back=3.39 numpy=0.90)

caveats: supersedes C1's unstable 48-75 us wall-minus-device estimate, which was measured by subtraction

c_bo_alloc_s.name: c_bo_alloc_s
c_bo_alloc_s.method: XRTTensor construction (BO allocation), median across the byte sweep
evidence: 4096 B: pack=    3.74 us deblock=    2.30 us (alloc=7979.46 sync=3.74 back=1.41 numpy=0.89)
16384 B: pack=    3.55 us deblock=    2.37 us (alloc=6378.15 sync=3.55 back=1.48 numpy=0.89)
65536 B: pack=    6.81 us deblock=    3.18 us (alloc=6683.02 sync=6.81 back=1.90 numpy=1.27)
262144 B: pack=    8.58 us deblock=    4.29 us (alloc=6362.26 sync=8.58 back=3.39 numpy=0.90)
1048576 B: pack=   22.14 us deblock=   10.66 us (alloc=6467.43 sync=22.14 back=9.67 numpy=0.99)
4194304 B: pack=   69.98 us deblock=   34.68 us (alloc=7020.09 sync=69.98 back=33.89 numpy=0.79)
size-independent: 8.0 ms at 4096 B vs 7.0 ms at 4194304 B
caveats: SETUP ONLY — never add this to a per-dispatch prediction. Real code allocates once and reuses.
A first cut of this bench folded alloc into pack and got a negative c_pack (-9 GB/s); size-independence is what proves it is not a per-byte cost.

bw_feed_bytes_s.name: bw_feed_bytes_s
bw_feed_bytes_s.method: tile stream, 1 word touched per tile; slope of npu_time vs bytes at 4 columns
caveats: slope basis: the C1 dispatch floor lands in the intercept, not the bandwidth
cheapest possible consumer; a real kernel may not reach this feed rate
target-specific measurement for npu2/AIE2P; do not transfer it across NPU generations

bw_feed_per_col_bytes_s.name: bw_feed_per_col_bytes_s
bw_feed_per_col_bytes_s.method: aggregate C2 slope bandwidth divided by 4 active columns
caveats: the model scales this rate to the requested active-column count
C2 is capped at four columns by its one-output-BO-per-column measurement layout

c_task_issue_s.name: c_task_issue_s
c_task_issue_s.method: constant 8388608 B payload, tile-size sweep; slope of npu_time vs tile count
caveats: single column; per-task cost may differ when several columns issue concurrently
tile size is bounded by L1 (M1: 64 KiB) and the BD budget (M6: 16/core)

bw_drain_bytes_s.name: bw_drain_bytes_s
bw_drain_bytes_s.method: core writes 1 word/tile, DMA drains; slope of npu_time vs bytes at 5 columns
caveats: slope basis; C1 floor lands in the intercept
measured separately from feed because R64 found drain, not feed, was the limiter

bw_drain_per_col_bytes_s.name: bw_drain_per_col_bytes_s
bw_drain_per_col_bytes_s.method: aggregate C5 slope bandwidth divided by 5 active columns
caveats: the model scales this rate to the requested active-column count
C5 is capped at five columns by its one-output-BO-per-column measurement layout and the 5-argument DPU ABI

fill_drain_s.name: fill_drain_s
fill_drain_s.method: fifo-depth sweep at constant payload; per-depth residual over the best pipelined time
caveats: small term on npu2: compare it with that target's measured C1 dispatch floor
L1 (M1) bounds depth*tile_bytes; aie2p saw depth-4 build failures for the same reason (R58/E2)
